h: Preparing the Heart for the Hidden Light of Torah

p: we make request for the secrets:
"And may He show us the secrets
that are spoken in a whisper;
may He reveal to us its reasons," etc.
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא, פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג כח, ב)
(Ra'aya Mehemna, on this parsha, Zohar III 28b):
"for light is called raz, secret," etc.
And this is as we said:
that are spoken in a whisper"
refers to the primordial light that was hidden;
as is said in the Midrash (Bereishis Rabbah 3:4):
"Just as I heard it in a whisper,
so I have told it to you in a whisper," etc.
רַק עַל יְדֵי שֶׁשּׁוֹמֵעַ הַדָּבָר מִפִּיו
only through hearing the matter from his mouth,
and the matter breaks through into the heart of the listener
כְּמוֹ בְּכָל עִנְיְנֵי תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
as in all matters of Torah she'b'al peh,
which are mentioned in the Mishnah
in the name of Shmuel HaKatan and the like
And it is stated in the Ra'aya Mehemna (Zohar III 28a):
"that once the evil mixture has passed away
the secrets of the Torah must be covered,
כְּבוֹד אֱלֹקִים הַסְתֵּר דָּבָר (מִשְׁלֵי כה, ב)
'It is the glory of God to conceal a matter' (Mishlei 25:2)
until they pass away from the world,
and there are no kings but Yisrael," etc.;
'and the glory of God' — 'to search out a matter,'" etc.
דְּמַה שֶּׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מְכַסֶּה הַסּוֹדוֹת
that the Holy One, blessed be He, covers the secrets
because there is a yetzer hara,
which is the leaven in the dough.
וְאִיתָא (בְּרַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא, חֵלֶק ג רלב, ב)
And it is stated (Ra'aya Mehemna, Zohar III 232b):
'And who holds back? The leaven in the dough'";
"'From among you, an offering to Hashem' (Shemos 35:5)
and not from the erev rav," etc.;
the leaven in the dough holds back," etc.
And as long as there is the leaven in the dough,
there is fear to reveal the secrets,
at what he is not permitted,
along the lines of what we find (Chagigah 14b):
and of him the verse says (Mishlei 25:16):
'Have you found honey? Eat only as much as is enough for you,'" etc.
"and there are no kings but Yisrael,
for all Yisrael are sons of kings," etc.
and regarding Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him, we find
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה מג, ה)
וּמִכָּל מָקוֹם מָצִינוּ בַּגְּמָרָא (בָּבָא מְצִיעָא פג, א)
Nevertheless we find in the Gemara (Bava Metzia 83a):
a feast like Shlomo's in his time," etc.,
"for they are the sons of Avraham, Yitzchak and Yaakov";
of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,

p: But all the Avos are called kings:
and Avraham and Yitzchak the two arms,
and Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
is a chariot for the Name Havayah;
"I am king and you are queen";
and "the glory of kings is to search out a matter."
for regarding Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him, we find
וּבְמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה (וַיֵּרָא, בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה מט, ב)
and in the Midrash Rabbah (Vayeira, Bereishis Rabbah 49:2):
סוֹד ה׳ לִירֵאָיו (תְּהִלִּים כה, יד) כוּ׳
"'The secret of Hashem is for those who fear Him' (Tehillim 25:14), etc.;
Avraham — this is the one who fears," etc.
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב רג, א)
And it is stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 203a):
To hand over Shabbos to them as before," etc.;
For for the mitzvah of Shabbos too
and that is the leaven in the dough,
and once the erev rav pass away,
then "the glory of kings is to search out a matter,"
and they then merit the secrets.
And this is what is said:
"Moshe rejoices in the gift of his portion,"
"for You called him a faithful servant";
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁלּוֹ גִּילָּה הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
that is, to him the Holy One, blessed be He, revealed
"In all My house he is faithful"
at something that does not pertain to him.
we make request for the primordial light,
that are spoken in a whisper."
For surely the holy Arizal did not compose
for every one of Yisrael merits
to rectify the leaven in the dough,
from "the heart of the fool to his left" (Koheles 10:2);
"Great peace have those who love Your Torah,
and they have no stumbling block."
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (סוּכָּה נב, א)
along the lines of what they said (Sukkah 52a):
who are "those who love Your Torah,"
to transgress the commandments of Hashem
rather, it comes to mislead them,
to set before them darkness as light,
and this it can do even with great people,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁמָּצִינוּ בְּיַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
as we find with Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
that it came to mislead him,
"It appeared to him as a talmid chacham";
that is, it appeared to him
as a rav showing the way of Hashem;
he did not want to walk at his right,
"One who walks at his teacher's right," etc.
And this is called a stumbling block,
"And before the blind you shall not place a stumbling block";
that is, he is blind regarding the matter
"Great peace have those who love Your Torah,"
for through the words of Torah they merit
is from the accusation of the yetzer hara
"There is no peace in my bones because of my sin";
and they merit "and they have no stumbling block,"
which is to empty out from the fool's heart
that is separated from Yisrael on Shabbos;
they merit the secrets of the Torah.
And every one can merit this
and this is "the glory of kings is to search out a matter."
